subject: GPU floorplan sync & timeline for pilot (Codex Health)
messages:
From: Emma Singh <emma.singh@codexhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: james.allen@codexhealth.com
Date: 2029-10-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GPU floorplan sync & timeline for pilot (Codex Health)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the model throughput looked promising. We’re trying to lock schedules with our SRE and procurement teams so we can run the 6-week pilot before year-end. A couple of asks as we decide:

- Target steady-state throughput: 250 concurrent req/s (p99 latency target ~220 ms).
- Expected peak: 400 req/s for short bursts (1–5 min).
- Model: finetuned Llama-derivative, 70B, KV cache heavy; inference memory profile: ~48GB/runtime with warm KV.
- Pilot start window: earliest 2029-11-04, preferred 2029-11-11.

Can you confirm internal GPU availability for Nov and whether Redwood can place a soft-hold / provisional reservation against capacity to ensure runway? If you need to map to instance shapes or node counts, happy to share usage curves. Procurement will want an initial estimate they can use for budget planning.

Attachments: pilot_spec_v1.pdf (pdf, 220KB)

Best,
Emma
Emma Singh | CTO, Codex Health
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Singh <emma.singh@codexhealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, logan_wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-10-06T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GPU floorplan sync & timeline for pilot (Codex Health)

Emma — appreciate the clear targets. Looping in Marcus and Logan (runtime/ops) and Monica (sales ops) to get a quick availability check and a provisional ask we can share with procurement. A few items we’ll need to size conservatively:

- Effective batch sizes and token rates once KV caching is warm; Marcus — can you assume 30 tokens/sec per stream for sizing unless we get a measurement?
- Are you planning multi-model routing or a single variant in the pilot? If multi-variant, that increases the node headroom required.

Monica — can you prepare a capacity estimate sheet we can send to Codex procurement (ballpark monthly $ and node count) and note that this is a soft-hold request with a requested confirmation by 2029-10-18?

Emma — I’ll confirm internal steps for a provisional reservation and any SLA gating items we need from your side (SAML domain, SOC2 contact).

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, logan_wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Singh <emma.singh@codexhealth.com>
Date: 2029-10-06T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GPU floorplan sync & timeline for pilot (Codex Health)

Karthik / team — quick ops take after reviewing Emma’s numbers and the model profile:

Sizing assumptions (guard-band included):
- Model footprint: 48GB VRAM per instance (quantization not applied for pilot).
- Serving instance we recommend: 1x A100-80GB / instance with multi-process runtime; effective concurrent streams per GPU: ~5 with warm KV when targeting 220ms p99.
- To support 250 steady concurrent req/s: estimate 50 active streams (5 per GPU) => 10 GPUs.
- Peak buffer to 400 req/s for short bursts: target absorb with burst queue + autoscale; recommend a soft-hold for an extra 4 GPUs (total 14) to avoid cold-start sloshing during the pilot ramp.
- Recommended standby reservation: 14 GPUs for the pilot window, with a commit window of 6 weeks.

Risks / notes:
- If Codex wants 99.9% latency SLO tighter than 220ms, we should add another +2 GPUs for headroom.
- If we apply 4-bit quantization and re-compile kernels, effective capacity could increase to ~7 streams/GPU; we can explore after initial pilot acceptance.

I’ll attach a quick capacity_estimate_v2.xlsx with the node math and monthly cost bands. If Ops approves a soft-hold we’ll flag these GPUs in the inventory system under DEAL-4782 soft-hold tag and prevent allocation to other late-stage deals for the requested window.

Attachments: capacity_estimate_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 280KB)

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Head of Serving Capacity, Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@codexhealth.com, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, logan_wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Emma Singh <emma.singh@codexhealth.com>
Date: 2029-10-06T13:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GPU floorplan sync & timeline for pilot (Codex Health)

Hi Emma / Codex procurement team —

Thanks for the details. I’ve attached a draft pilot_runbook_draft.pdf that summarizes the operational plan and the capacity estimate Marcus shared. Quick summary for procurement:

- Proposed soft-hold: 14 A100-80GB equivalent GPUs from 2029-11-04 through 2029-12-16 (6 weeks + 2-day buffer).
- Billing approach for pilot: usage-based hourly billing with a capped provisional estimate for monthly budgeting. Estimate range: $98k–$132k for the period depending on actual hours used and autoscale.
- Next steps we need from Codex: final confirmation of pilot start date by 2029-10-18, signed MPA addendum for a provisional reserve, and SOC2 point of contact for onboarding.

If you can confirm by end of next week, we’ll tag the capacity in our inventory as a soft-hold under DEAL-4782 and issue a non-binding allocation notice to your procurement email.

Attachments: pilot_runbook_draft.pdf (pdf, 320KB)

Best,
Monica Patel | Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Singh <emma.singh@codexhealth.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Allen <james.allen@codexhealth.com>, procurement@codexhealth.com
Date: 2029-10-06T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GPU floorplan sync & timeline for pilot (Codex Health)

All — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear calc. We’ll review the estimate and pilot runbook internally; procurement will aim to respond with a confirmation and an initial redline by 2029-10-16. For now, please proceed with marking the 14 GPU soft-hold against DEAL-4782 and share the HubSpot link you mentioned so my procurement lead can reference it.

Emma
Emma Singh | CTO, Codex Health
